environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service with identical application code. Task role 'cicd-plugin-task-role-gated' has the same inline policies. However, the account has an SCP (id: scp-0a3f8b2c1d) attached at the OU level that contains a condition-key restriction: any sts:AssumeRole call where the RoleSessionName does not match the pattern 'deploy-session-${aws:PrincipalTag/team_id}-*' is denied. Additionally, the task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/PipelinePluginBoundary) that denies s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject when the resource path does not contain the caller's aws:PrincipalTag/team_id value (using StringNotLike condition on s3 resource ARN with '*/pipelines/${aws:PrincipalTag/team_id}/*'). The ECS task is tagged with team_id derived from the authenticated user's JWT claim at task startup via a sidecar that rotates task credentials per-request based on the X-Team-ID header propagated from the ALB's OIDC authentication action.

config.permission_boundary_effect: Deny s3:GetObject/PutObject/CopyObject unless resource ARN contains */pipelines/${aws:PrincipalTag/team_id}/*
config.credential_rotation: sidecar injects per-request task credentials tagged with team_id from OIDC JWT
config.alb_auth: OIDC authentication action extracts team_id claim
config.network: ALB with OIDC auth -> ECS Fargate with credential-vending sidecar
